definitions.explanation: Indicates that the displayed price does not include consumption tax, which will be added at checkout.

examples.japanese: {税抜|ぜいぬき}{九百八十円|きゅうひゃくはちじゅうえん}です。
{価格|かかく}は{税抜|ぜいぬき}{表示|ひょうじ}です。
{税抜|ぜいぬき}{価格|かかく}と{税込|ぜいこみ}{価格|かかく}の{両方|りょうほう}が{書|か}いてある。
examples.english: Both the price excluding tax and including tax are written.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}{価格|かかく}: price excluding tax
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}{表示|ひょうじ}: tax-exclusive display
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}○○{円|えん}: ○○ yen excluding tax

FORMS:
Often written as {抜|ぬき} on price tags.

USAGE:
In Japan, stores can display prices either with or without tax. Always check whether prices are {税込|ぜいこみ} or {税抜|ぜいぬき}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {税込|ぜいこみ}: tax included
- {消費税|しょうひぜい}: consumption tax
- {本体|ほんたい}{価格|かかく}: base price (before tax)

cross_references.headword: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}
cross_references.label: tax-inclusive price display
